name: Apache Iceberg REST catalog
summary: Append Parquet files that Ogun published to object storage to tables in any catalog that implements the Apache Iceberg REST catalog specification.

fields.name: access_token
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: uri
settings.label: Catalog URI
settings.help: Base URL of the REST catalog.

settings.name: warehouse
settings.label: Warehouse
settings.help: Passed to the catalog when it asks for one.

settings.name: table_namespace
settings.label: Table namespace
settings.help: Namespace that holds the tables Ogun appends to.

settings.name: oauth2_server_uri
settings.label: OAuth2 token endpoint
settings.help: Token endpoint of your identity provider. Empty means the catalog's own.

egress.note: The hosts of the uri and oauth2_server_uri settings, on the ports in those URLs.

operators.summary: Append published Parquet data files to an Iceberg table through the REST catalog.

notes: The catalog holds table metadata only; the data files stay in object storage that the matching storage connector writes, so add its domains to the same egress approval. Catalogs that require request signing or vended storage credentials need the vendor's documentation.
